exposure: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) diagnosis and activity
cohort: The study included 13 pregnant women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) diagnosed according to American College of Rheumatology (ACR) criteria.
finding: SLE pregnancies carry elevated risks of pre-eclampsia, fetal loss, and prematurity, with improved outcomes observed by maintaining hydroxychloroquine and tailored anticoagulation.
